decisions.reason: As a software product tightly aligned with the firm's announced move toward connected, data-driven infrastructure management and already kept after an earlier portfolio cleanup, it is likely to be retained because sunk development effort and public commitment favor continuation.

This recently launched automation and system software fits the firm's strategic direction and core capabilities, and management inclined to escalation of commitment would likely give it more time and attribute any weaker uptake to normal adoption and project-cycle delays rather than withdraw it quickly.
